targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, SUM(view_count) AS "Total Views" FROM page_views_1min WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start
SELECT MAX(session_count) FROM active_sessions_5min WHERE window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT page_url, SUM(view_count) AS views FROM page_views_1min WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY page_url ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT step, SUM(event_count) AS events FROM funnel_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY step ORDER BY events DESC
SELECT window_start AS time, page_url AS metric, unique_users AS value FROM page_views_1min WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start
